objective: Approve the exact AGY auditor model identifier gemini-3.1-pro-preview for embedded-audit proof while preserving existing CI and signed-attestation trust boundaries.

authority.operator_instruction: Add Gemini 3.1 Pro through AGY to the approved embedded-auditor model list.

in: Add gemini-3.1-pro-preview to the canonical embedded_audit auditor_model enum.
Document AGY with Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview as an approved Tier-1 audit route when exact invocation and model selection are proven.
Add regression coverage proving the exact AGY/model pair validates and near-match/unapproved identifiers remain rejected.
Record that local signed attestation remains the path for personal AGY authentication; hosted CI provider wiring is unchanged.
out: Installing or authenticating AGY in GitHub Actions.
Adding Google credentials, OAuth state, cookies, tokens, or keyring material to the repository or CI.
Changing audit verdict rules or signer trust.

invariants: The exact model identifier is gemini-3.1-pro-preview; aliases such as pro or generic branding are insufficient for exact-model proof.
A passing proof must still record auditor_tool, auditor_model, exact invocation, exit code, findings, and remaining risks.
AGY authentication stays local unless a separately reviewed CI credential design is approved.
Candidate PR code remains unexecuted by the independent audit workflow.

The admission PR must be audited under the pre-change schema using auditor_model=gemini with the exact AGY model selector preserved in invocation/provenance; the new enum must not be used to bootstrap its own approval.
proof_requirements: repo root, branch, base SHA, and head SHA
AGY version and exact model-selection evidence without credentials
independent audit report bound to the final code head
PR Steward readiness after merge gates

audit.reason: This changes the canonical proof schema and auditor authority allowlist.
audit.bootstrap_rule: Audit this PR under the current main schema. Record auditor_tool=agy and auditor_model=gemini, while the invocation and report prove --model gemini-3.1-pro-preview. After merge, later proofs may record auditor_model=gemini-3.1-pro-preview directly.

rollback: Revert the approval commit. Existing generic gemini proofs remain valid; exact gemini-3.1-pro-preview proofs created after the change would again fail schema validation and must not be accepted after rollback.
stop_conditions: AGY help/models output does not prove the exact selector.
The selected AGY session silently falls back to another model.
Any change requires CI credentials or workflow mutation.
Independent audit is missing, stale, or not bound to the final code head.
